/exterior-painting.metaDescription: Plan exterior house painting in Southern Ontario. Explore siding, brick, stucco and exterior details, with preparation and scope suited to your property.
/exterior-painting.intro: Exterior house painting across Southern Ontario, planned around your siding, masonry and architectural details. We Paint Siding helps you identify the surfaces, preparation and colour changes that belong in one coordinated exterior project.
paragraphs: A complete exterior repaint brings several decisions together: which materials can be coated, what needs repair first, how the colours will meet and how the property can be accessed. Our exterior painting services cover suitable siding, brick, stucco, wood and visible roofline or entrance details, with a separate plan for the materials on your building.

Start by walking around every elevation. Note fading, loose paint, damaged components and places that stay damp. A sound proposal distinguishes surface preparation from repairs and identifies work that falls outside the repaint. It should also explain protection around windows, landscaping and adjoining property.

For homeowners in Burlington, Oakville and surrounding Southern Ontario communities, colour is only one part of the decision. Sun exposure, drying conditions, building height and access can affect the practical plan. Explore the individual exterior services below for material-specific guidance, then share photos and your location to define a project scope.
/exterior-painting.localCopy: Exterior painting availability is confirmed for the property and proposed work. A siding repaint in Milton, a brick colour change in Hamilton and a commercial façade project in Toronto each need different information. Include your city, postal code, the elevations to be painted and any access restrictions when preparing a request.
faqs: How do I compare exterior house painting quotes?

Compare the same elevations and surfaces, then review cleaning, preparation, repairs, primer, finish products and protection. Access equipment and any excluded components should be clear. A low headline price is difficult to assess when the underlying scopes differ.
When can exterior painting be scheduled in Southern Ontario?

The coating instructions and actual site conditions guide the work. Temperature, rain, humidity, sun exposure and drying time all matter. Discuss suitable conditions and the proposed sequence rather than relying on a fixed calendar date alone.
Should siding, trim and doors be painted together?

They can be coordinated as one project when suitable, but each component still needs its own preparation and finish requirements. List the surfaces and colours to include so a walls-only quote is not mistaken for a complete exterior repaint.
What should I send before discussing an exterior painting quote?

Send your city or postal code, full photos of each elevation, close-ups of worn areas and the changes you want. Include height or access concerns and known repairs. The website form saves a draft for you to share; it does not send an online enquiry.

/interior-painting.metaTitle: Interior Painting Southern Ontario | We Paint Siding
/interior-painting.metaDescription: Explore interior painting in Southern Ontario: walls, ceilings, trim, doors, basements and cabinets. Plan colours, preparation and your room-by-room scope.
/interior-painting.intro: Interior painting in Southern Ontario for the rooms and details you use every day. Explore wall, ceiling, trim, door, basement and cabinet painting, with preparation and colour choices planned around your home rather than a one-size-fits-all room package.
paragraphs: A well-planned interior repaint starts with an inventory of rooms and surfaces. Decide whether you want walls only, a more complete room update, or a focused change to doors, trim or cabinets. These are different scopes, even when they use a coordinated palette, and each needs an appropriate preparation and finish discussion.

The way you live in the space matters. Furniture, storage, children’s rooms, home offices and connecting hallways can affect access and sequencing. Existing plaster, drywall, woodwork and cabinetry also need different attention. Identify dents, unstable coatings and recurring stains before choosing the final colours.

For interior painting in Mississauga, Burlington and nearby communities, useful planning information includes room photos, ceiling height, included surfaces and the finishes you are keeping. Check colour samples under the lights you use every day. Then explore the six services below to understand the details that matter for each part of the project.
/interior-painting.localCopy: We discuss interior painting projects across the GTA, Golden Horseshoe and surrounding Southern Ontario communities. Tell us whether your Oakville room refresh, Hamilton cabinet update or Waterloo basement project includes walls, ceilings, doors or trim. Your city, postal code and room details help establish the right scope and confirm availability.
faqs: Which interior painting services do you offer?

The six interior services are basement painting, cabinet painting, trim painting, door painting, wall painting and ceiling painting. You can discuss one service or combine suitable surfaces in a clearly defined project scope.
What affects the cost of interior painting?

Room dimensions, ceiling height, included surfaces, preparation, protection and colour changes all influence the work. Cabinet components and detailed trim should be identified separately. Comparing equivalent scopes is more useful than comparing a room price with no description of what it includes.
Can interior painting be planned while we live in the home?

Discuss room use, furniture, household access and the selected coating’s drying requirements before scheduling. The sequence should identify which spaces are available at each stage and any restrictions that need to be agreed.
Do wall painting quotes include ceilings and trim?

Only when those surfaces are listed. A walls-only refresh, a ceiling repaint and a full room colour update involve different work. Name doors, baseboards, casings and other details explicitly when preparing your request.
